mapper.select: SELECT I.SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID, I.PLAN_DAY_ID, I.TIME_SLOT, I.POSITION_NO, I.PLACE_PROVIDER, I.EXTERNAL_PLACE_ID, I.PLACE_NAME_SNAPSHOT, I.CATEGORY_SNAPSHOT, I.ADDRESS_SNAPSHOT, I.LATITUDE_SNAPSHOT, I.LONGITUDE_SNAPSHOT, I.IMAGE_URL_SNAPSHOT, I.DESCRIPTION_SNAPSHOT, I.ITEM_VERSION FROM PLAN_SCHEDULE_ITEM I JOIN PLAN_DAY D ON D.PLAN_DAY_ID = I.PLAN_DAY_ID WHERE D.PLAN_ID = #{planId} ORDER BY D.DAY_NO ASC, CASE I.TIME_SLOT WHEN 'MORNING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, I.POSITION_NO ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLAN_SCHEDULE_ITEM I JOIN PLAN_DAY D ON D.PLAN_DAY_ID = I.PLAN_DAY_ID WHERE D.PLAN_ID = #{planId}

SELECT IMAGE_URL_SNAPSHOT FROM ( SELECT I.IMAGE_URL_SNAPSHOT FROM PLAN_SCHEDULE_ITEM I JOIN PLAN_DAY D ON D.PLAN_DAY_ID = I.PLAN_DAY_ID WHERE D.PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND I.IMAGE_URL_SNAPSHOT IS NOT NULL AND I.CATEGORY_SNAPSHOT IN ( '관광지', '문화시설', '축제·공연·행사', '여행코스', '레포츠', '관광정보', '쇼핑' ) ORDER BY CASE I.CATEGORY_SNAPSHOT WHEN '관광지' THEN 0 WHEN '문화시설' THEN 1 WHEN '축제·공연·행사' THEN 2 WHEN '여행코스' THEN 3 WHEN '레포츠' THEN 4 WHEN '관광정보' THEN 5 WHEN '쇼핑' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END ASC, D.DAY_NO ASC, CASE I.TIME_SLOT WHEN 'MORNING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, I.POSITION_NO ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID, PLAN_DAY_ID, TIME_SLOT, POSITION_NO, PLACE_PROVIDER, EXTERNAL_PLACE_ID, PLACE_NAME_SNAPSHOT, CATEGORY_SNAPSHOT, ADDRESS_SNAPSHOT, LATITUDE_SNAPSHOT, LONGITUDE_SNAPSHOT, IMAGE_URL_SNAPSHOT, DESCRIPTION_SNAPSHOT, ITEM_VERSION FROM PLAN_SCHEDULE_ITEM WHERE SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID = #{scheduleItemId} AND PLAN_DAY_ID = #{planDayId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLAN_SCHEDULE_ITEM ( SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID, PLAN_DAY_ID, TIME_SLOT, POSITION_NO, PLACE_PROVIDER, EXTERNAL_PLACE_ID, PLACE_NAME_SNAPSHOT, CATEGORY_SNAPSHOT, ADDRESS_SNAPSHOT, LATITUDE_SNAPSHOT, LONGITUDE_SNAPSHOT, IMAGE_URL_SNAPSHOT, DESCRIPTION_SNAPSHOT, ITEM_VERSION ) VALUES ( #{scheduleItemId}, #{planDayId}, #{timeSlot}, #{positionNo}, #{placeProvider}, #{externalPlaceId}, #{placeName}, #{categoryName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{latitude,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{longitude,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{imageUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{itemVersion} )
